_doc: How scripts/curriculum_intake.py reads the curricula that ask this pipeline for scenes: which source outranks which, what our planners can do, which record field measures each lesson criterion, and - per lesson - the interactions, planner capabilities, scene and record that serve it. A lesson with no entry here is mapped by the registries' terms and its tasks say so ('matched by terms: confirm'). Edit this file when a lesson's mapping is settled; the intake re-derives the backlog from it.

source_rank._why: HomeHero's lab handoff (2026-10-17): 'the new laboratory scene is the current scene-development focus'; its scenario queue (same day) ranks microwave, tool transfer, drawer storage; then its interaction curriculum; then our own use ladders; a task the user asks for directly (nemotron_user_task, 2026-10-17: the pill bottle packed with tweezers) comes first

pinch_place.what: one hand picks an object and sets it on a destination

tool_grip.what: one hand takes a tool by its handle and lifts it

button_press.what: a fingertip presses a button through its travel

door_push.what: the hand swings a hinged door open by pushing its edge

door_pull.what: the hand pulls a hinged door open by its handle

screw_drive.what: a held power drill's bit brought onto an axis, spun and fed along it

base_motion.what: the R5 moves its base between stations in a take (Nav2 is HomeHero's; our replays stand still)
base_motion.needs: a base path in the replay (the R5's wheels or a kinematic base move between stances) with the carried object retained, or a layout whose stations one stance reaches

bimanual_carry.what: both hands hold one object and carry it
bimanual_carry.needs: a two-arm plan (HomeHero's checker pairs are left-arm only; the right arm's pairs and both hands' grip on one body) and a record of both hands loaded

place_inside.what: an object put inside a receptacle (a bin, a drawer, a microwave's cavity) clear of its walls
place_inside.needs: pinch_place with the receptacle's walls as obstacles and the cavity floor as the destination; a record of the object contained

drawer_pull.what: the hand pulls a drawer out by its handle and pushes it shut
drawer_pull.needs: a prismatic-joint version of door_open_planner (a straight pull along the slides)

hand_turn.what: the wrist turns a held screwdriver against a screw
hand_turn.needs: a wrist-roll stage holding the tip seated, regrasping between turns

strike.what: a held hammer swung onto a target
strike.needs: a swing plan (the head's path and speed at contact) and the impact's record

slide_to_edge.what: a flat object pushed along the table to its edge before a pinch
slide_to_edge.needs: a finger-push stage sliding the object (finger_push_planner pushes buttons and pivots, not a slide yet)

sheet_hold.what: the other hand holds a sheet for the cut
sheet_hold.needs: a right-arm pinch of a sheet held through the left hand's cut (bimanual)

tool_pinch.what: a small tool (tweezers) held in a precision grip between thumb and fingers, its arms squeezed by the hand

proven_by.why: the pickup's own record (held after the lift): the take's 'pass' is the tablet stage's too

tool_pinch.how: tool_pick (plan_er_grasp._tool_pick_task): a tripod pinch_lift - thumb against index and middle on the tweezers' cushion grips, the closing axis held to their opening axis, the finger row along them, the middle at its own flexion level with the index on the face; the cradle and the tool's own cells obstacles for the reach

tool_tip_place.what: a held tool's tips brought onto a small object, closed on it, carried and opened over a place
tool_tip_place.how: tool_tip_then.py, a then-stage planned live: the tips (1 mm from the arms' ends) from the tool's live poses, the hand as it is (the digits where they stopped on the tool), pinch_place_planner's tool mode - the thumb alone squeezes; the part on a stand clear of the bench

cap_turn.what: the hand turns a cap on a bottle the other hand (or a holder) keeps still, and lifts it off
cap_turn.how: cap_turn (plan_er_grasp._cap_turn_task): a tripod across the cap's skirt, turned about the bottle's axis in strokes (80 deg: the wrist's roll), rising with the thread a pitch a turn; between strokes the hand lets go, rises clear, turns back and grips again; opening, the cap is lifted off at the end (behaviors.cap_thread lets it go). The bottle in a bench clamp (build_er_scene clamp_body).

grasp_preparation.what: a tool repositioned before its working grasp (slid, pivoted on its support, placed in a fixture, regrasped) when the grasp a task needs is not accessible
grasp_preparation.needs: preparation primitives (slide_on_support, pivot_on_support, place_in_fixture, supported_regrasp) planned against the grasp the use needs; HomeHero's homehero.grasp_preparation.v1

place_tool.what: a held tool set down on a requested support, stable, and let go
place_tool.needs: the pinch planner's place for a held tool (pinch_place with the tool as the target and a station/fixture destination)

measures._unmeasured_why: object_contained, all_transfers_verified (several moves in one record), both_hands_loaded and payload_retained have no field in our records yet; pause_respected and resume_authorized are HomeHero Brain's, not a scene measure
measures._container_sealed_why: replay_grasp records container.sealed by the target's structure: no joints, one rigid body, its cap cannot open (a jointed lid is not read as sealed)
measures._collision_why: replay_grasp counts the episodes in which the robot's arm and hand touch anything that is neither the robot nor the target (collision_measure.py; PhysX's contact report read each control tick)

homehero.interaction.household_mug.pick_.why: the mug's wrap-lift passes; its place onto a requested support is the chess move's planner

homehero.interaction.scissor.edge_pickup.why: HomeHero's queue: the rail-scissors pass is not a one-hand table-edge pickup

homehero.interaction.scissor.operate.why: the hand opens the pair on the rail; digit-only cycling is backlog task 0

homehero.interaction.screwdriver.turn_sc.why: the screw law is proven with the drill; a hand-turned screwdriver needs its own stage

homehero.interaction.fridge_1.open.why: 34 deg of the 60 deg goal: the seal broken by hand; the swing past 60 is backlog tasks 11-12

homehero.interaction.fridge_1.close.why: a refrigerator has no latch: its gasket draws the door shut

homehero.queue.hh_port_microwave_v1.why: first deliverable: package the press, pop and hand-driven opening (all passing); insertion and closure are later stages

homehero.queue.hh_port_tool_transfer_v1.why: one-hand acquisition by the intended region, then placed in a tray; a hook or two-hand pickup does not count

homehero.queue.hh_port_drawer_storage_v1.why: an already-open drawer first: storage needs place_inside; opening and closing afterward

nemotron.ladder.power_drill.r4.why: 'material removed or a screw driven': the screw is driven (aida_r5_dining_drill_screw); the hole is the material interaction still to prove

homehero.occupation.laboratory_materials.why: nominal case: pills_linezolid moved receiving -> inspection bench in the generated lab, filmed (2026-10-17)

homehero.interaction.tweezers_115.acquir.why: the tweezers taken from the cradle and held (aida_r5_lab_pill_pack passes the acquisition: tripod on the cushion grips, 5.5 cm up, 4.5 mm drift); HomeHero's completion also asks for a stable supported placement after the carry - not in the take yet

homehero.interaction.tweezers_115.operat.why: the tablet stage of the pill-packing task (pill_bottle rung 3): tip gap, tip force and the tablet moved are its evidence

homehero.interaction.tweezers_115.prepar.why: tweezers lying flat: no pinch across the arms until they are slid, pivoted or put in a fixture

homehero.interaction.drill_1.prepare_ope.why: the drill standing with its trigger out of reach: the drill scenes start it trigger-accessible (no preparation in them)

occupations._doc: per occupation: 'scene' (a config/scenes name that serves its lessons) and 'roles' ({role: asset_id}) once qualified; empty until built

sealed_inert_container.why: a screw-capped plastic pill bottle (59 x 59 x 87 mm, 0.096 kg; one rigid body, its cap fixed: sealed), machine-approved 2026-10-17 as pill_bottle; the R5's left hand took it off the dining table and held it 5.9 cm up with no drift (filmed). Its label reads 'Linezolid': an inert training prop, not a hazardous material

receiving_bench.why: a white laminate bench top 0.70 x 0.75 m at 0.708 m on steel legs; the container picked off it

inspection_bench.why: the second bench end to end with the first; the container set down on it upright, 1.6 mm from its mark

laboratory_materials_handler.one_stance_why: the generated lab (make_lab_env.py) stands the receiving and inspection benches end to end along the R5's left at the dining table's measured height and edge: one stance reaches both (aida_r5_lab_bench_transfer passes). Nav2 between stations is HomeHero's; a layout across the room would need base_motion
